verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says one line of code logs requests from OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini, the Vercel AI SDK and more. The docs show drop-in OpenAI SDK instrumentation ("add two lines to your existing OpenAI code"). Community users confirm one-line setup, including a LangChain user who was running in 4 minutes. missing for 10: dedicated first-party integration docs for LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK (evidenced only by the README list), hands-on corroboration of the Vercel AI SDK integration.
